# V11 results (generated by report_v11.py; all numbers measured on the lab PC)

V11 = YOLOv9-S-TI-Lite 640 (same architecture as V9/V10), trained from COCO weights for 40 epochs on the V10 training set + label fixes, with zoom-out, small-flame paste and camera-degradation augmentation. Evaluation sets are byte-identical to V10. FASDD test not used.

## Data changes

Label fix: `{'positive_images': 25833, 'candidates': 503, 'boxes': {'add_box': 130, 'drop_image': 221, 'ignore': 152}, 'images': {'add_box': 125, 'drop_image': 214, 'ignore': 130}, 'rule': 'Step 1: find flames left UNBOXED inside training images that do have flame boxes (never audited before).\n\nFrozen V10 runs over every unique positive training image of manifests_v10/train.json. A candidate is a V10 box\nwith score >= .50 that has IoU < .10 with every labelled box and whose centre lies outside every labelled box.\nEach candidate crop is scored with the same zero-shot CLIP fire scorer used in V10 (P(fire) vs nuisance prompts).\n\nDecision rule (fixed in PROTOCOL_V11.md before any result):\n  add_box    V10 score >= .60 and CLIP P(fire) >= .70  -> the V10 box is added as a label\n  drop_image V10 score >= .50 and CLIP P(fire) >= .30 otherwise (ambiguous) -> the whole image leaves training\n  ignore     CLIP P(fire) < .30 -> image unchanged (V10 false positive on clutter)\n  One drop_image candidate drops its image even if the image also has add_box candidates.\nSpot check (step 2 gate): 72 random add_box crops (seed 0) are shown on 2 sheets. If fewer than 80% are real\nphysical flames, every add_box becomes drop_image (fall back to the conservative V10 policy).\nValidation / hn_val / test are never touched.'}`

Build: `{'label_mode': 'drop', 'spotcheck': {'add_box_total': 72, 'add_box_real_flame': 48, 'reviewer': 'lab Claude (AI, not human)'}, 'v10_train_records': 86383, 'v11_train_records': 87518, 'images_dropped': 326, 'images_with_added_boxes': 0, 'boxes_added': 0, 'extra_records': 1461, 'positive_share': 0.3052743435636098, 'flame_bank_crops': 6000, 'eval_manifests_sha256': {'val.json': '311bf7d7a99dbd1cebf538bb2e03bc03f58f3681128aa8e6815d6fe89d4bd22c', 'validation_full.json': '6536a6479bf172466ce08f49a5d38be25af2c73f3ffd7ee30a8fbe4a323f9665', 'hn_val.json': 'bfda9b09e2f7d8b4702b0cfb79d41d8198dde126229dcc34469930ac0e23c4bf', 'test.json': '292da636d16e47ed0bff141543b665969ef090562c403c869ef4fdda811c27a0'}, 'train_sha256': 'bdafa525f1bdfe3993dda281b0f2373e53e36e3079e7f490d6d6446ab2138a83'}`
